IMPORTANT: the real schema's operationKind value is "context-clear" (hyphen), not "context_clear" (underscore) as BBP-207/208/209 assumed; title is inferred (a human label), only detail/message is the field directly observed in the raw event.

systemOperationParentChange.title: Thread re-parented
systemOperationParentChange._note: MAJOR CORRECTION to the current mapping: the real schema nests old/new parent under a parentChange: {action, previousParentThreadId, previousParentThreadTitle, nextParentThreadId, nextParentThreadTitle} object, NOT flat oldParentId/newParentId fields as BBP-207/208/209 implemented. No real parent-change event was observed in the 3 sampled threads (none were re-parented); this row is schema-accurate but its values are illustrative, not captured.

systemBundleCandidate._note: Illustrative; the bare systemKind:"debug"/"reconnect" variant (TimelineRowBase + title, no operationKind) was not directly observed — thread-provisioning events in the raw log all look like the 'operation' variant above, not the bare debug/reconnect one.
